{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''individual''' served as a [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A trio of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives attempted to lure the general into a trap on [[Baes Logia]]; however, the [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] was ultimately [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Brain/Legends|mentally]] unstable Alliance operative [[Graf Yonna]].<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>
